_source: huggingface/transformers 5.14.1 gemma4_unified (the revision Lightricks/LTX-2 @ d151147 pins)

no_layer_scalar.why: every `layer_scalar` forced to its 1.0 initializer (the port that never read the buffer)

v_from_normed_k.why: under `attention_k_eq_v`, V read off the normed+rotated K instead of the raw projection output

no_window.why: `sliding_attention` layers run a plain causal mask, ignoring `sliding_window`

full_rope_as_partial.why: `full_attention` layers use a leading-slice partial RoPE (`2i/rotary_dim`) instead of the proportional schedule (`2i/head_dim` + zero tail)

kv_shared._why: num_kv_shared_layers: 2 + use_double_wide_mlp — the trailing layers project no K/V of their own and reuse the last earlier layer of their type, with a double-width MLP
